response: The current prediction equations for estimating basal metabolic rate (BMR) may not be entirely applicable to the Chinese population. Studies have shown that the commonly used equations, such as the Harris-Benedict equation, may overestimate or underestimate BMR in Chinese individuals. This is due to differences in body composition, lifestyle, and genetic factors between Chinese and Western populations. Therefore, population-specific equations or adjustments to existing equations may be necessary to accurately estimate BMR in Chinese individuals.
